description: This Java source file contains test utility code for managing database containers (MySQL and PostgreSQL) within the OpenMRS core testing framework. It handles starting and configuring containerized database instances for integration testing.

classes.name: Containers
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to ensure MySQL or PostgreSQL containers are running for testing purposes, with configuration and setup.

methods.name: ensureDatabaseRunning
methods.description: Public method to ensure that the appropriate database container (MySQL or PostgreSQL) is running based on system properties.

methods.name: ensureMySQLRunning
methods.description: Private method that initializes and starts a MySQLContainer with specific configurations if it is not already running.

methods.name: ensurePostgreSQLRunning
methods.description: Private method that initializes and starts a PostgreSQLContainer with specified configurations if it is not already running.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Private method to set up runtime properties and ensure the database schema is created using Liquibase utilities.
